messages:
Carla (Sales): quick FYI — ACME wants 'lotus-3b' available in EU + APAC and to pin to v1.2. They specifically ask for a quantized q4 build and target p95 latency <=150ms in EU. Can we triage?
Alex (PM): thanks — what's the ask timeline and will they pay for Dedicated or expect Hosted?
Carla (Sales): pilot starts in 6 weeks, likely Dedicated if SLA holds but they'll try Hosted first. budget TBD.
Ben (Support): forwarding the customer's note: "need region availability and version pin; compliance checks for APAC country list; must preserve inference parity with our current med/float model."
Dan (Catalog): noted. Quick catalog notes: lotus-3b v1.2 is in ingestion staging but we don't have a q4 artifact validated yet. Also model license is CC-BY-NC-SA — needs legal review for APAC distribution.
Eri (Infra): short checklist from infra side: hardware compatibility, quant kernels, and cache warming. On our current EU fleet, q4 paths are supported on Ampere A100s but there are perf regressions on older T4 pools.
Eri (Infra): snippet of proposed deployment config:
```
regions: [eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1]
variants:
  - name: v1.2-q4
    quant: q4_0
    batch_size_slo: 4
    max_seq: 1024
```
Dan (Catalog): thanks — I'll queue validation tests: 1) correctness diff vs float32 on our eval set, 2) perf matrix across EU instance types, 3) size/regulatory metadata update. ETA 10 business days.
Marta (Legal): CC-BY-NC-SA is tricky for commercial distribution in some APAC markets. Need to confirm ACME's use case (internal vs re-distribute). Please have Sales get a short statement of intended use.
Alex (PM): agreed. Action items: (1) Dan to run correctness + perf (10bd) (2) Eri to flag infra gaps and an interim fallback plan (old T4 -> fallback to float32 or route to eu-highmem) (3) Sales get ACME usage note and budget confirmation (4) Legal to advise export/license constraints.
Carla (Sales): I'll ping ACME today for the usage note and budget.
Ben (Support): adding customer SLA ask: they want p95 <=150ms EU and <200ms APAC during pilot burst windows. putting that in the ticket.
catalog-bot: ingestion-status: lotus-3b v1.2 - staging artifact found, q4 artifact: missing, tests: pending.
Eri (Infra): early estimate: to guarantee p95 150ms in EU we need to reserve some Dedicated A100s or accept routing to lower-latency regions; I'll list capacity options after Dan's perf matrix. :eyes:
Dan (Catalog): will attach perf CSV and a short note on semantic parity when done. If q4 fails parity, we can offer v1.2 float32 in EU and q4 in APAC as a fallback.
Alex (PM): good. I'll create a backlog ticket with the above ACME pilot scope and inclusion criteria: parity delta <=2% on eval, p95 SLOs met on dedicated baseline, legal sign-off for APAC. We'll reconvene in 3 business days.
Carla (Sales): thanks team — I'll update ACME with tentative plan and timeline. :thumbsup:
Marta (Legal): noted, I'll start a license check and post constraints in the ticket.
Ben (Support): putting a reminder to capture customer acceptance criteria once we have perf + parity numbers.
Alex (PM): end of thread for now — next sync after Dan posts results.
